messages:
katie: FYI incoming from Sapphire (onboarding). They ran our standard e2e and hit huge p95 spikes for chat/embeds on their Dedicated pool. Sales is worried they’ll push pause unless we can explain.
dmitri: +1. They’re spinning up a small Dedicated reservation for pilot. SLA conversation depends on us confirming stable p95 under their load. They reported p95 ~1.2s for chat and 900ms for embeddings during their test bursts (target ~200ms).

katie: Attaching the short repro they sent and a dashboard link: https://redwood.metrics/sapphire/requests?range=1h
infra-bot: Alert (1745236805): routing.queue_delay spike on dedicated-cluster-12. avg_queue_ms=420, p95_queue_ms=980. Related hosts: gpu-node-12b, gpu-node-12c.

raj: Thanks, catching up. Initial instincts: sounds like KV cache miss storms + a small batch window bump from their payload distribution. Need: sample payloads, their QPS pattern, model + quantization config they used. katie can you paste the payload?

katie: Paste of their minimal chat payload (redacted):
```
{
  "model": "rw-1-small-v1",
  "input_tokens": 120,
  "context_history": 3,
  "tools": []
}
```
They said test harness ramps 10->60 rps over 2m then 0. Tests run from eu-west.

amelia: Putting this on product radar — this is a pilot that could convert to a paid Dedicated seat. We need acceptance criteria for the pilot (p95 <= 250ms for chat, embeddings p95 <= 300ms under their 60rps pattern) or an explicit mitigation plan. Suggest we label as P1 product intake for now until triage confirms root cause.

raj: For triage plan: 1) reproduce in staging on dedicated-cluster-serial with same model/quant. 2) run KV warm path vs cold path test. 3) check routing policies — are requests landing on single node due to affinity? 4) temporarily enable prefix caching and reduced batch window for Sapphire's org on Dedicated to evaluate.

mika: I can run a short canary on prod dedicated in the eu region tonight if we want to test the mitigation (re-route to secondary pool + decrease batch_time_ms to 8). Need signoff.

dmitri: Sales: they want us to commit to a mitigation within 48h or they’ll ask for credits. Not a hard deadline but high pressure.

amelia: OK. Action items: raj to validate reproduction and test cache/window changes (owner: raj). mika to coordinate canary (owner: mika). katie to collect exact QPS traces and sample headers (owner: katie). I’ll create a ticket in backlog and attach acceptance criteria (owner: amelia).

raj: Will try to reproduce now. Quick note: if it's a KV cache cold-miss storm, short term fallback is to route Sapphire org to a slightly older quantized variant that has lower memory pressure (trade-off perf/latency). That buys us time for a proper fix in runtime.

katie: They also noted a small tail of long requests tied to embedding generation after the chat flow (maybe post-processing). I’ll ask them to send a captured trace with timings per stage.

mika: If we do a canary tonight, I’ll run with reduced concurrency and keep rollback plan ready. If raj confirms the reproducer, lets do it.

amelia: I created backlog ticket PROD-1428 and set priority=p1 for product-review. Linking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-1428

dmitri: Thanks all. Keep me posted — I’ll tell the customer we’re actively triaging and planning a possible mitigation tonight. :thumbsup:

raj: Update (1745237450): reproduced on staging. Confirmed p95 spikes when warmups are absent and batch windows increase under ramp. Next step: test decreased batch window + prefix cache prewarm. Will update within 2h.

amelia: Great. Add any suggested customer-facing wording for katie to use in update.

katie: Draft for customer: "We saw a latency spike during your ramp that looks like a combination of KV cache cold misses and batching timing. We're running a targeted canary tonight to validate two mitigations (cache prewarm & reduced batch window). If successful, we'll apply a safe routing policy so your pilot stays within p95 targets while we implement runtime improvements." Thoughts?

amelia: LGTM. Marking this thread as active triage.
